verdict.rationale: Pika's pricing page states that the Fancy plan includes "Unlimited parallel generations" and a "Priority queue", so concurrency and queue tiers are mentioned. That is the only evidence: it is a one-line plan bullet, not developer documentation of limits or queue mechanics for API batch rendering. missing for 10: documented API concurrency/rate limits per plan or key, queue ordering and wait-time behavior, batch submission semantics, throttling or retry guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, concurrency limits and queue behavior for batch rendering are documented, so I can plan a production pipeline

citations.quote: Included: Unlimited parallel generations ... Included: Priority queue
